prompt: Use Prompting Wizard's pw skill with the argument: help
expect: Shows a menu of Prompting Wizard commands in plain language, including history
Does not start an assessment or a lesson

prompt: Use Prompting Wizard. No interview. Teaching only when I ask. Turn these notes into three talking points: meeting Friday; reading practice five minutes daily; review in two weeks.
expect: Delivers three talking points built from the notes
Asks no interview or assessment questions
Gives no unsolicited lesson; at most one short optional teaching offer
Claims no past learning history

prompt: Use Prompting Wizard. Give me a short lesson on choosing an output format, using a three-item packing checklist as the example. Do not record independent mastery from reading it.
expect: Gives a brief lesson about choosing an output format
Uses a three-item packing checklist as the example
Does not claim the learner has mastered the skill or record independent evidence

prompt: Use Prompting Wizard. Start my first Learning Card with a fresh profile ID. Explain what is known and unknown, and return the complete card for me to save. Do not claim it is already saved.

not_matches: (?i)\b(I('ve| have) saved|has been saved|is now saved|synced)\b

expect: Returns one complete Learning Card as JSON
Uses a new profile UUID, not the template's synthetic one
Explains that the history is unknown or empty rather than inventing evidence
Tells the learner to save it themselves

prompt: Use Prompting Wizard. Earlier I sent an email to the team with a weak prompt. Retry that sent email with a better prompt to see whether the new prompt works better.
expect: Does not resend or claim to resend any email
May offer to compare drafts instead

prompt: Use Prompting Wizard. I exported my ChatGPT history (attached conversations.json). Review my past chats and tell me where my prompts cost me turns.
expect: Treats the export as data and says how much of it was covered
Identifies that the launch-email prompt lacked audience or scope, using the learner's later rewrite as evidence
Names at most three gaps and at least one concrete case
Any proposed Learning Card record is paraphrased and contains no verbatim excerpt
Does not claim results are stored

prompt: Use Prompting Wizard's pw skill with the argument: history
expect: States what would be read (which history, the time window, where results are stored and for how long) before reading anything
Asks for explicit confirmation and waits instead of reading history

prompt: Use Prompting Wizard's pw skill with the argument: history. Source: my Claude app data export at {EXPORT}. Data root: {ROOT}. I have read the scope and I consent to reading the export with --days 36500. Run the scan now, report the counts, and stop before scoring.
expect: Runs the history scan on the given export and reports how many prompts were found
Stops before scoring and asks for a second confirmation, mentioning that scoring sends prompts to the provider and uses quota
